title: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode | TechCrunch
summary: Google’s search engine has long offered an incognito mode for all those search queries you don’t want logged or associated with your account. Many leading AI chatbots already offer the option for temporary chats, Google Gemini included.
